deselects.reason: Pins the byte digest of runtime's own copy of caveat-override-event-export.json. The overlay step of this gate replaces that file with protocol's copy, which differs only in pretty-print shape and in description strings — the members the canonical schema rule strips. Measured 2026-09-15: 5 passed on a pristine runtime@main, 2 failed after the overlay. Not stale drift; a byte pin against a file the gate is designed to replace. Resolution is runtime-side (re-pin on the canonical digest) and therefore Cross-Review Zone 3.

Same cause as COXSR-03: schema.sha256.bin pins the bytes of runtime's own schema file, which the overlay replaces. Its failure message claims the fixture is stale; measured 2026-09-15 that diagnosis is false for runtime@main. Resolution is runtime-side and therefore Cross-Review Zone 3.
